'''Garva's Turn''' was a curved portion of the [[Mephyt River|Krisa River]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was used as a racetrack for the [[Nashal River Race]].<ref name="SWG:NRT" />
